chunks: When this was revealed: “and a retaining ear would retain it”
The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said: “It is your ear, O Ali.”

key_terms.أُذُنٌ: ear; used figuratively for receptivity and preservation of revealed knowledge
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.عَلِيُّ: Imam Ali عليه السلام, identified here as the referent of the verse
key_terms.نَزَلَتْ: was revealed; indicates the descent of the Quranic verse

ai.seo_question: Who is meant by “the retaining ear” in the verse “and a retaining ear would retain it”?
ai.summary: This report explains the phrase “and a retaining ear would retain it” as referring specifically to Imam Ali عليه السلام. It highlights his unique receptivity, preservation, and comprehension of the divinely conveyed truth through the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله. In Shia tradition, it is among the reports indicating his special rank in knowledge and wilayah.
